title: You Don't Need More Time
topic: Waiting for the perfect moment vs taking one small action
core_message: We keep thinking, planning and waiting for the perfect moment, when one small action would teach us more than another hour of overthinking.
central_insight: Clarity doesn't always come before action. Sometimes it begins when you move.
visual_metaphor: A tiny figure stands before an enormous closed golden door. It hesitates, takes four slow planted steps in a straight line, touches the door once, and a thin line of warm gold light opens. One character, one door, one decision, one payoff.
narration_style: calm, confident, unhurried; natural emphasis; deliberate pauses between sentences

narration.text: You keep waiting for the perfect moment.
One more plan. One more day.
But clarity doesn't always come before action.
Sometimes, it begins when you move.

caption_density: one short line per sentence of narration, no boxes, nothing on screen during the hold or the end card
